title: Adobe Bridge Genuine Software Service Incorrect Permission Assignment Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Adobe Bridge. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the AdobeGCData directory by the Adobe Genuine Software Service. The issue results from incorrect permissions set on this directory. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
